what_this_is: A SOURCE-VALIDITY preflight for the P14 preregistration, run BEFORE the design was frozen. It records what the publisher serves and whether the rows the frozen contract needs are actually there. It contains NO economic or predictive outcome: no return, no signal value, no correlation, no PnL, no gate evaluation.
result_state: P14 NATIVE 1m TRADE-FLOW SCREEN: NOT YET RUN

publisher.name: Binance public data archive
publisher.digest_source: the .zip.CHECKSUM object Binance publishes beside each archive

span.why_this_start: 2020-01 is the first month of the committed multiclock_v1 source every clock in this repository is cut from. The start is inherited from that source, not chosen for P14, and no later start was considered.

schema.required_field_availability: present and finite on every parsed row

timestamp_units.resolved: per file from the magnitude of open_time

integrity.zero_volume_treatment: a bar with volume 0 has tfi_ratio 0 by the frozen definition and is excluded from every agreement denominator. The rule is in the preregistration, and these counts are recorded so that it can never be mistaken for a response to one.

sufficiency.statement: Every bar of the committed 1m price grid is one row of these archives, and the taker-side split is present and finite on every one of them. The P14 information family therefore has NO gap surface of its own: it cannot be missing where the price grid is present. That is the P13 failure mode made structurally impossible rather than merely measured.
sufficiency.gaps_are_shared_not_independent: the missing intervals are the exchange outages multiclock_v1 section 5 already enumerates - 15 discontinuities, longest 5h54m on 2020-02-19, last on 2023-03-24. A minute absent here is a minute with no bar, so neither source creates a decision row for it.

aggtrades_cross_check.purpose: prove, against the publisher own trade tape, that taker_buy_base_asset_volume is the aggressive-buy volume and that is_buyer_maker false is an aggressive BUY
aggtrades_cross_check.chosen_because: one per timestamp era and one mid-history, fixed before the check ran
aggtrades_cross_check.conclusion: identity, not approximation. Summing aggTrades quantity where is_buyer_maker is false reproduces taker_buy_base_asset_volume to float64 summation noise on every minute checked, in both the millisecond and the microsecond era.

verdict_means: the sources the frozen P14 contract names are complete for every observation that contract will read. It is a statement about source validity and about nothing else.
raw_archive_note: the archives are not committed. They are described here by published path, published digest and byte size, and are re-fetchable from the canonical base URL.
